title: Say Pinabpablin Kamarerwa ya Nankuestion ed Autoridad
intro: Diad saray annals na Quran, walay sakey a too ya nagmaliw ya bantog so kayamanan tan pikakabat to. Sayan kamarerwa so pinmaway ed dalin a walaan na saray alahas tan kayamanan ya amabigla ed saray manbabantay, balet ta say puso ra so nagmaliw ya mapaatagey lapud inkamapaatagey. Mila kayod sikami legan min uusaren so misteryo na sakey ed saray sankasakbayan ya salaysay na Quran, ya say materyal ya inkabantog et onsabi ed makapaabeba ya anggaan diad silong na mismon dalin ya angitarya na kayamanan da.
clues: Pinmaway ak ed dalin ya akadekorasyon na saray alahas ya akaalay pakanengneng na amin.
Walaan ak na baleg a kayamanan tan aralem a pikakabat ya angibiig ed siak ed arum.
Nen sinmabi so sakey a mensahero ya ontatawag ed totoo ed si Allah, kinuwestiyon ko so autoridad da tekep na inkamapaatagey.
Saray walad kaliberliber ko et nanbubulong ya aliwan say pabor nen Allah so lapuan na kayamanan ko.
Mankelaw iray totook ed inkabantog ko tan pinirawat da so kapalaran a mipara ed siak.
Saray mararakep ya istruktura ko et inakmon ed dalin bilang dusa na Dios.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Propeta Shu'aib
Qarun (Korah)
Say mayaman a kaiba nen Propeta Musa
Bal'am ibn Ba'ura
Say ministro nen Zul-Qarnain

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say pangipaalagey na balitok a kilaw a baka parad panagdayew
Mapaatagey ya panukuestion ed autoridad na sakey a propeta
Mantitipon na kayamanan manlapud sakey a bansan apektado na eras
Aglabay ya inabang so pikakabat ed saray iskolar
Say pankerew ed sakey a propeta na nanengneng a paneknek na kioli
trial.answer: Mapaatagey ya panukuestion ed autoridad na sakey a propeta

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say syudad na Midian
Saray palasyo ya linmereg ed dayat
Saray alahas tan kayamanan
Say mandarlang a kiew ed Palandey Sinai
Saray buer a patar na kadaanan ya Ehipto

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Nauman ya singa lusek na asin
Nipelag ed dayat ed pegley na karol tan daluyon
Inakmon na dalin a kaiba so amin a kayarian to
Intagey a mabilay ed tawen bilang tanda
Inekal na dalin ya walay magnayon ya pagbabawi
outcome.answer: Inakmon na dalin a kaiba so amin a kayarian to

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
